residency_notes: Fireworks serverless routes use the provider-managed GLOBAL multi-region. US, EUROPE, APAC, and single-region placement are deployment-level controls and are not inferred for these generic serverless routes.
prompt_training_notes: Fireworks says open-model inference prompts and generations are not logged or stored without explicit opt-in. Its public data-security page describes customer-controlled training workflows but does not establish a direct platform-wide inference prompt-training policy for every model route.
